title: Caller-managed scout suggestion sessions must disable agent finish tool
answers: When is the finish tool enabled for sandboxed agent sessions?
How to prevent sandboxed agents from self-terminating in caller-managed task runs?
Why is the finish tool hidden for scout_suggestions runs?
body:
Sessions originating from scout_suggestions must keep the agent-side finish tool disabled even when endRunWhenDone is set.
Enforced at: products/desktop/packages/harness/src/extensions/local-tools/tools/finish.ts:finishTool via the isEnabled predicate.
What breaks if skipped: The agent marks the session run as terminal at the end of its turn, preventing the caller from validating output, sending follow-up turns, or saving results.
says: Automated suggestions stop abruptly before we can review and save recommendations
AI scout session terminates itself before completing our verification step
Prevent automated suggestion agents from self closing before results are validated
The suggestion assistant closes the session before saving its generated review
